rationale: Semantic review of the first check for C10-command-value-length-survives-the-wire (artifact 4cd03e5aa3ec4080807408f6b3678c14, executed as ede08d08…). The item assesses requirement versus predicate, the constructibility premise, the oracle, identity, the observation path and the bounded consequences.

review_items.rationale: Requirement versus predicate: the claim is that a value the client can build must survive the codec or be rejected, and the predicate asserts value_matches on the round-trip event; the retained run reports false with the declared length, the decoded length and the consumed bytes all printed, so the assertion is evaluated on the codec's own output rather than on an inferred quantity. Entry and legality: both directions of the codec are the implementation's own and the harness calls them directly; the premise that such a value can enter the protocol rests on the command size being a configuration parameter (aws.conf sets 1000; the field carries up to 65535) rather than on a client drive, which is recorded as a limitation rather than assumed silently. Oracle and observation: value_matches compares the decoded bytes with the payload the harness built, and the wire-length event shows the encoder emitted all bytes, so the shortening is attributable to the length field rather than to a truncated write; identity is the shared subject field between the prerequisite and the result. Contrary evidence and limits: the shipped configuration's 1000-byte commands never reach the boundary, no replica reader is exercised so the desynchronisation's consequence on the following message is not observed, and whether the client library caps the size it builds was not read. No counterevidence was found that the codec preserves values in this scope.
review_items.report_title: 命令值长度在网络上被静默截断
review_items.report_answer: 经真实编解码往返：声明 70000 字节的值在线上写出 70013 字节，解码仅得 4464 字节（70000 mod 65536），且只消费 4477 字节，value_matches=false；剩余字节留在流中会错位后续消息边界。该结论成立的前提是“调用方可以构造超过 65535 字节的值”，这一点由命令大小是配置项支持（默认配置为 1000 字节，未触及该边界）。
limitations: the value is constructed by the harness; the client's own allocation cap was not read, so the premise that a caller can reach this size rests on the configuration being a parameter
the shipped configuration uses 1000-byte commands, so the default deployment never reaches the truncation
no replica reader consumes the shifted stream, so the desync's effect on the following message is unobserved
